rootDecorators.name: initBitwarden
rootDecorators.description: Initialize a Bitwarden Secrets Manager plugin instance for bitwarden() resolver

rootDecorators.name: initBwp
rootDecorators.description: Initialize a Bitwarden Password Manager (or Vaultwarden) plugin instance via the `bw` CLI

dataTypes.name: bitwardenAccessToken
dataTypes.typeDescription: Access token for a Bitwarden Secrets Manager machine account

validationRules.message: Access token must be in format: 0.<client_id>.<client_secret>:<encryption_key>

dataTypes.name: bitwardenSecretId
dataTypes.typeDescription: UUID that identifies a secret in Bitwarden Secrets Manager

validationRules.message: Secret ID must be a valid UUID

dataTypes.name: bitwardenOrganizationId
dataTypes.typeDescription: UUID that identifies an organization in Bitwarden

validationRules.message: Organization ID must be a valid UUID

dataTypes.name: bwSessionToken
dataTypes.typeDescription: Bitwarden CLI session token (output of `bw unlock`)

validationRules.message: Bitwarden session token must be a non-empty string

resolvers.name: bitwarden
resolvers.label: Fetch secret value from Bitwarden Secrets Manager

resolvers.name: bwp
resolvers.label: Fetch a field from a Bitwarden Password Manager / Vaultwarden vault item via the `bw` CLI
